title: Consumer prices rose 0.6% in September, putting annual inflation rate at 3.7% - CNBC
description: The consumer price index was expected to increase 0.6% in September on a monthly basis and 3.6% from a year ago, according to the Dow Jones consensus forecast.

title: Morgan Stanley tops estimates as equities trading revenue exceeds expectations by $909 million - CNBC
description: Morgan Stanley is expected to benefit from robust investment banking and equities trading revenue.

title: Cornell cancels fraternity parties over sexual assault case - BBC
description: The school has faced an uproar over how it handled assault allegations brought by a woman known as Jane Doe.

title: Prosecutor calls Russell Brand a ‘ruthless’ sexual predator at trial - NBC News
description: Russell Brand behaved as a “ruthless” sexual predator when he assaulted six women over the course of a decade, a prosecutor said Wednesday as she opened the rape and sexual assault case against the actor-comedian.

title: These common infections can cause cancer. Here’s what can lower your risk. - The Washington Post
description: Recent research indicates that infectious diseases cause around 12 percent of new cancer cases.
